title: Automate the Routine
summary: Build a reusable CSV summariser with error handling.
description: Complete a small Python utility that reads a CSV file and writes a JSON summary. It should accept command-line arguments, validate input, and report a useful error for malformed data. A starter script is provided; you are expected to improve it.
learning_objectives: Read a CSV file with headers
Handle malformed input without a traceback leak

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Separate parsing, summarising, and output writing into small jobs.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Use `csv.DictReader`, `argparse`, and `try/except` for expected input errors. Review the TODO in `summarize.py`.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Run `python3 summarize.py records.csv --output summary.json`. The summary must contain `records: 4`, `active: 3`, and `departments: ["engineering", "operations", "research"]`. Then verify malformed input exits nonzero with a short user-friendly error.
